evidence_candidates.source_locator: overview, MN-Core series, and resources sections
evidence_candidates.excerpt: Preferred Networks describes MN-Core as a domestically co-developed matrix accelerator used in operating computer clusters. Its MN-Core 2 materials describe a general development environment and support for HPC workloads in addition to AI software.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: Japan is pursuing both a heterogeneous national flagship architecture and domestically developed specialized AI accelerators with software support extending toward HPC workloads.
